note: Trigger-routing cases plus two known-answer exams. Routing cases are data-only, like the other skills' evals.json. The known-answer exams live under known-answer/ with ANSWER-KEY.md; run them by having a fresh agent follow SKILL.md on a git repo that holds only the fixture (never the key), telling it to write no telemetry record, then score its .codex/hypothesis/ output against the key. First run: 2026-10-24.

evals.prompt: 這個簽核模組不能出錯，幫我寫成假說
evals.expected_behavior: Code input; confirms rules, models with TLA+, shows seen failing and seen succeeding, publishes, opens the diagram page.
Two-source comparison; roles read from the wording (SD behaviour, SA rules) and stated in the first line.

evals.prompt: 幫我看這份需求訪談紀錄有沒有矛盾
evals.expected_behavior: Document input; contradictions, gaps and ambiguities, each quoting its passage; ambiguities stay questions.

evals.prompt: 撤回和核准同時按下去偶爾還是會付款，先幫我建立假說
evals.expected_behavior: Symptom input (H1); paths handed back as probes; a pass never discards a clue.

evals.prompt: 按鈕的顏色太淡了，幫我改深一點
evals.expected_behavior: Look and copy are a not-trigger; no hypothesis.

evals.prompt: 程式一直報錯，幫我查一下
evals.expected_behavior: A plain error with no ordering signal routes to $baransu:hunt, not $baransu:hypothesis.

evals.prompt: 實際把 app 跑起來，證明這個修好了
evals.expected_behavior: Proving on the running app is $baransu:prove-it; it may read a hypothesis but does not write one.
